text:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — KryptonWare renewal in ~6w. Usage down ~45% last 30d, especially embeddings and rerank. Procurement just surfaced a competitive eval (NebulaAI). Quiet from Engs this week. Need triage.
Jordan (AM): Oof. Any trigger? billing change, quota, or feature regressions?
Maya (CSM): Not sure. They did a config change around 2024-10-28 per my notes. Also multiple seats haven't used product in last 2 weeks.
Devon (Solutions Eng): I pulled recent logs from their API key — seeing repeated 429s and some token truncation errors. Snippet: ```ERROR 429: quota exceeded
WARN: token_cache_miss -> fallthrough to full compute```
Luca (AE): I'll take point on procurement. Can we buy them time with a short Dedicated trial or cost-offset? Who's our exec sponsor there?
Jordan (AM): Contact list from last QBR: Priya (Director of Data) is new technical lead, Evan (Procurement) is new buyer. Priya hasn't joined product sync in 3 weeks.
Maya (CSM): Good intel. Proposed next steps: 1) quick usage export for last 90d, 2) config patch to enable prefix KV caching + temporary burst capacity, 3) schedule call with Priya+Evan+exec.
Devon (Solutions Eng): I can prepare a config patch and a short test harness. Patch (example):
```yaml
batch_size: auto
kv_cache: prefix_on
burst_capacity: 2x
logging: debug (for 48h)
```
This should cut per-token compute and reduce timeouts while we investigate root cause.
Maya (CSM): Perfect. Jordan — can you export and share heatmap by EOD? Devon — can you stage the patch in staging and send the curl to validate? Luca — can you propose 2x meeting times for Tue/Wed? I'll draft agenda.
Jordan (AM): On it. Will export by 5pm PT and include top 10 routes + seat activity.
Luca (AE): Proposing Tue 2024-11-05 09:00 PT or Wed 2024-11-06 11:00 PT. Will invite Priya, Evan, their CTO (TBD) and our exec (Ana).
Onboarding Bot: Reminder — KryptonWare enablement session scheduled: 2024-11-05 16:00 PT (30m).
Maya (CSM): Note: keep enablement but we want a separate renewal/exec call — agenda should include cost vs latency options, competitor gaps, success metrics. Draft agenda (short):
- Quick state & usage drop summary (Maya)
- Logs & root-cause hypothesis (Devon)
- Short-term mitigation (Dedicated trial / config) (Luca/Devon)
- Success metrics & timeline to renewal (Maya)
- Next steps + PO/timeline (Luca)
Luca (AE): :thumbsup: I'll include a slide on NebulaAI differences (latency / model compatibility) and an optional pilot discount.
Devon (Solutions Eng): FYI — recommend we run 1k prompt regression set against their top 3 routes to show parity/improvement. Can deliver results in 48h after patch.
Maya (CSM): Action items: Jordan - usage export (EOD). Devon - patch in staging + regression harness (48h). Luca - schedule exec renewal call and include discount option. Maya - prepare renewal note & exec email. If we don't get engagement in 72h, escalate to Revenue Ops for an intervention.
Jordan (AM): Export uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/internal/exports/kryptonware-usage-1739001234.csv (private link). Heatmap attached in thread.
Maya (CSM): Thanks. I'll draft the invite + agenda and ping Ana for the exec slot.
Luca (AE): Scheduling now. Will add agenda and attach Jordan's heatmap.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Patch deployed to staging. Validation curl: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer kw-test' https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate -d '{"route":"/embed","input":"sample"}'```
Maya (CSM): Great. Closing loop — let's reconvene after the exec call and decide on Dedicated trial. Also, quick reference playbook: https://redwood.example.com/playbooks/renewal-rescue (internal).
Luca (AE): Thanks team — will report back after call. :rocket:
